title: Calling George Noory's show while Bob Hastings was the guest

tellings.quote: Hastings was one I had talked to when I called George Dory

plain: A former nuclear missile guard named Richard Barth says he once phoned in to Coast to Coast AM, a late-night American radio talk show hosted by George Noory, on a night when a man named Bob Hastings was the guest. Barth tells it himself to Michels, in passing, as the way he first came to talk with Hastings, and he does not say when the call happened.
